scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Let's practice your English, Arun. Where are you going?
Arun says: I go to home.
Miss Nova says: Udeshichathu, 'I am going home'. 'Go to' places-nu vendiyullathaanu, pakshe 'home'-nu 'to' venda.
Arun says: Yes, I am going home. I am very hurry.
Miss Nova says: 'I am in a hurry' ennaanu ithu parayenda correct way.
Arun says: Okay, thank you.

Yes, I am going home. I am very hurry. 'I am in a hurry' ennaanu ithu parayenda correct way. Okay, thank you.

scenes.script:
Arun says: Wait, ningal aara? Ente car-il irunnu enne enganeya correct cheyyunnathu?
Miss Nova says: Njan Miss Nova, Supernova AI-yile ningalude personal AI teacher. Njan ningalude exact level analyze cheythu ningalkku mathramayi oru personalized plan ready aakkum.
Arun says: Pakshe njan silly mistakes varuthiyalo? Enikku naanam thonnum.
Miss Nova says: Ivide ningale aarum nokkunnumilla, judge cheyyunnumilla. Ningal aayiram mistakes varuthiyaalum, njan orikkalum kaliyaakkaathe athu correct cheythu tharaam.

scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Athupole, njan logic nammude swantham Malayalathil explain cheyyum, so ellam nannaayi manassilaakum.
Arun says: Ithinu nalla expense aakumo?
Miss Nova says: Ithu valare affordable aanu, parayan poyal normal coaching classes-nekkal ezhu madangu laabhamaanu.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied Malayalam-specific rules: recast character to Arun; used 'samsaarikkan' instead of 'speak cheyyan'; used 'Malayalathil' instead of 'Malayalam-il'; used 'kaliyaakkaathe' for 'without laughing/mocking'; translated '7 times cheaper' using the natural multiplier 'ezhu madangu laabhamaanu'. All quoted English grammar teaching lines are preserved verbatim.

violations.quote: a Google Play Store app installation pop-up overlay appears in the center of the screen
violations.why: A fake Google Play Store installation pop-up overlay is a misleading mechanic/fake UI that violates Meta's ad policies.
violations.fix: Replace the fake Play Store pop-up overlay with a standard, non-interactive Supernova AI logo and a 'Download Now' call-to-action button.

violations.quote: The graphic displays pricing information, showing a discounted rate.
violations.why: The visual includes unapproved pricing and discount information which must only come from the team.
violations.fix: Remove the pricing and discount graphic overlay, keeping only the comparative cost dialogue.

safety.summary: The ad contains a severe Meta policy violation (fake Play Store UI overlay) and a severe pricing violation (unapproved pricing/discount graphic).
